<!--
Thanks for contributing to awesome-blazing-rust!

THE RULE: no numbers, no entry.
Entries without public measurements go to the Candidates section with a note on what evidence is needed.
-->

## Entry

```markdown
- [name](url) — what it is. **Blazing:** <numbers with units and context>. **Arch:** `patterns`
```

## Checklist

- [ ] The `Blazing:` line contains **measured numbers** with context (link the benchmark in the entry or PR)
- [ ] Every `Arch:` tag exists in [PATTERNS.md](../blob/main/PATTERNS.md) (new tags: add them to the index with a 2-3 line note)
- [ ] The project is not already listed (single primary section per project)
- [ ] Section fits the project's domain
- [ ] Links are live and point to the canonical repo

## For Candidates-section additions

- [ ] Describe what evidence is missing and how it could be produced
